name: Isocontour Shading with Curvature
definition: A shading method for isosurfaces that uses surface features including first curvature (k1), second curvature (k2), mean curvature ((k1+k2)/2), Gaussian curvature (k1*k2), or a curvature texture.
summary: Isocontour Shading with Curvature enhances isosurface visuals by highlighting specific levels and modulating color via curvature data, distinguishing itself from methods relying solely on geometric position.
